newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: ROKISHKIS SHAREHOLDERS OK SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ROKISHKIS SHAREHOLDERS OK SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Lithuania's Rokishkis Cheese said on Monday that its shareholders had approved a proposal to issue 200,000 new shares with a face value of ten litas.

The shareholders also decided that the minimum price for the shares would be 44 litas and the current shareholders will have no priority rights to buy into the issue, the company's director general, Antanas Tiumpa, told Reuters.
"We are in talks with foreign investors, and they will acquire the whole issue," he said.
"One of the potential investors is Williams De Broe," he said.
Williams De Broe already has a stake of around 12.5 percent in the cheese maker, which is one of three corporates on the Vilnius bourse's elite official list.
The company's current share capital is 30.24 million litas.
"We intend to sign a concrete agreement this week with one of the investors," Tiumpa added.
"The main condition for the investor is that they convert the company's shares quoted on the bourse and the whole new issue into gross depository receipts (GDRs)," he said.
